run_experiment: run a Sacred experiment by calling the Run instance to execute the main function with observers
log_scalar_metric: log a scalar metric value with an optional step number to the Run metrics logger
add_resource_file: add a file as a resource to the Run so observers track its path and md5 sum
add_artifact_file: add a file as an artifact to the Run with optional metadata and content type
open_resource_file: open a file and register it as a resource with observers in one call
